items.label: Section A
items.explain: Đoạn A nêu hai mục tiêu của sở thú: “SHOW PEOPLE how wonderful they are” và “HIGHLIGHT the research and conservation efforts” → v (Two clear educational goals).

items.label: Section B
items.explain: Đoạn B: “This comfortable SYMBIOTIC RELATIONSHIP has led to the growth of coral reefs” → ii (Cooperation beneath the waves).

items.label: Section C
items.explain: Đoạn C: so sánh “RAINFORESTS OF THE SEA” bị “DISMISSED BY SOME naturalists” → iv (Disagreement about the accuracy of a certain phrase).

items.label: Section D
items.explain: Đoạn D: “scientists ADVISE that MORE THAN 90% of reefs COULD BE LOST BY 2050” → vii (A warning of further trouble ahead).

items.label: Section E
items.explain: Đoạn E: “scientists ARE TRYING to pinpoint hardy types of coral that could survive” → iii (Working to lessen the problems). Heading i (Tried and tested solutions) không dùng: các cách này còn đang thử, chưa “tried and tested”.

items.label: Section F
items.explain: Đoạn F: cho công chúng thấy tiến bộ để “ENCOURAGE THEM TO BELIEVE that we can do something” → vi (Promoting hope).

sections.instructions: Câu 14–19: chọn heading i–vii cho từng đoạn A–F. Đọc tóm tắt 1 dòng mỗi đoạn trước, rồi mới chọn.

items.label: School
items.explain: “The school will be on that road, AT THE CORNER OF THE SECOND TURNING TO THE LEFT.”

items.label: Sports centre
items.explain: “on the WESTERN SIDE of the development, JUST BELOW the road that branches off from London Road.”

items.label: Clinic
items.explain: “JUST BELOW this [the lake], TO THE RIGHT OF a street of houses.”

items.label: Community centre
items.explain: “the community centre will be ADJOINING this” (dãy nhà cho người trên 65 tuổi, phía đông bắc).

items.label: Supermarket
items.explain: “a supermarket BETWEEN THE TWO ENTRANCES to the development”, ngay phía nam ba cây lớn gần London Road.

items.label: Playground
items.explain: “the playground will be IN THAT CURVE, with nice views of the lake.”

sections.instructions: Câu 15–20: ghi chữ cái A–I. Đặt bút ở lối vào phía nam (South Entrance) và đi theo người nói.
